groups.name: sweep-matrix
groups.source:
// @rush/1
outer = circle_curve(center: [0,0,0],normal: [0,0,1],radius: 0.5mm)
hole = circle_curve(center: [0,0,0],normal: [0,0,-1],radius: 0.2mm)
show brep_progressive_miter_sweep([[outer],[hole]],
 points: [[0,0,0],[0,0,10mm],[10mm,0,10mm],[10mm,10mm,15mm]],miter_limit: 2,normal: [1,0,0],closed: false,
 scale: {degree: 1,knots: [0,0,1,1],values: [1,1],weights: [1,1]},
 twist: {degree: 1,knots: [0,0,1,1],values: [0deg,0deg],weights: [1,1]},
 cap_correction_tolerance: 0.000000001mm,cap_correction_quantum: 0.0000000000009094947017729282mm,cap_correction_max_work: 100000,
 circle_correction_tolerance: 0.0000000001mm,circle_correction_max_work: 100000,
 retained_wall_max_injectivity_cells: 100000,
 initial_steps: 1,max_steps: 1,max_deviation: 0.01mm
).brep_tessellate(2)
